name: American Perpetual — product & clearing
tagline: No-expiry single-stock future, held by hourly funding, cleared at OCC
summary: A cash-settled, no-expiry security future on 100 shares of a U.S. stock or ETF, held to its stock by an hourly funding rate (TWAP of (Mark − Index)/Index ÷ 24) and listed as one 101-name class on MIAX Futures. OCC clears funding as ordinary variation inside daily settlement, so there is no liquidation engine, insurance fund or auto-deleveraging. Fully specified (124-page spec, 38-page OCC Clearing Brief); nothing filed or signed as of Sep 30, 2026.

name: American Perpetual — regulatory road
tagline: Recognition, not relief: a security future under existing law
summary: The perpetual is argued to be a security future because funding supplies 'future delivery' as continuous convergence, so CEA §1a(47)(B)(i) excludes it from 'swap'. No exemption, no-action or pilot is sought. The path is a confidential Harmonization letter to both Chairmen, then one §41.23(b) request for all 101 names, Form 19b-7 and Form 19b-4 (Rule 3.3.2) on the same day, with the Kalshi BTC-perp order (May 29, 2026) cited as persuasive. Every paper was drafted and unfiled at Sep 30, 2026.

summary: This is the member-side build every carrying firm does once to carry American Perpetual's perps. A firm reads feed message 18 and the funding file, books four rules, shows seventeen display items and ties out to one OCC Funding Adjustment line. Every later asset class reuses the build unchanged; it is prepared in the Launch Partner Brief and UTS Annex C, and no firm has engaged yet.

name: Market Maker Program
tagline: The funding print as the published borrow rate of U.S. equities
summary: This pod covers the pitch and recommended terms for market makers: one book per name, $0.40 a side, no rebates, and a quoting standard modeled on MIAX's B500 program. The thesis is that makers set the Mark, and so the hourly funding print, an exchange-published per-name financing rate that competes with bilateral stock loan. MIAX sets the final terms; designation interest is taken name by name.

ideas.one_liner: Hard-to-borrow names trade at a discount; shorts pay and longs collect — no locate, no borrow desk, no recall

name: The competitive field
tagline: CME's dated relaunch and four perpetual filers, July–September 2026
summary: These are the venues that moved while the data room was being finished. CME relaunched dated single-stock futures on July 27; Kalshi, Coinbase and Bitnomial filed perpetual security futures on Sept 18; OG.com/Nadex followed on Sept 24; Robinhood announced U.S. crypto perps on Sept 29. AP's answer is architecture: one fungible contract at OCC, hourly funding as a borrow market, dividends by rule and no exemption sought.

name: One rail, every asset
tagline: A new class is a new reference feed and a contract multiplier
summary: This is AP's program after equities. Once OCC carries hourly funding inside variation and firms wire the four booking rules, any underlying that passes five tests lists on the same rails. Equities, crypto majors, and FX with gold and silver pass; foreign indices pass behind a license; rates, copper, compute, volatility and pre-IPO are parked or refused, each with its reason. One license at one rate covers every later class.

name: Crypto majors on the rail
tagline: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP perps, cleared at OCC
summary: The second class is hourly-funded perps on the four coins that carry 91% of listable spot flow. They reference CF Benchmarks' per-second indices (the BRTI for bitcoin), and any FCM carries them in a futures account. Bitcoin files for §40.3 approval on the record of the May 2026 order, and the other three self-certify behind it. The stated preference is 24/7 from day one, with the equity session as fallback; this is where Saheb's 2025–26 crypto and 24/7 ideas land.

name: World indices by the ratio method
tagline: Nikkei, then KOSPI 200 and Hang Seng TECH, once licensed
summary: These are dollar-per-point perps on foreign indices. They reference the official index in home hours and the last close times a home-futures ratio overnight, and they pause when nothing real trades. The class passes the tests but waits for a license and is never the first to launch; its switch is the only new engine piece in the whole program.
